newsitem.title: YEMEN: Saudi interior minister departs Yemen after talks.
newsitem.headline: Saudi interior minister departs Yemen after talks.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister Prince Nayef left Yemen on Tuesday after a second round of talks with President Ali Abdullah Saleh, an official said.
On Monday, he met with Saleh and delivered a letter from the Saudi monarch King Fahd.

The message dealt with issues of mutual concern and ways of enhancing the "brotherly ties" between the two neighbouring countries, official Yemeni television said. It did not disclose details of the letter's contents.
Prince Nayef one-day visit was aimed at following up on talks held in August between Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan and Yemeni officials, including discussions on their mutual borders.

Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a potentially oil and gas-rich border area before the two sides signed last year a memorandum of understanding to resolve the 60-year-old border dispute.
Prince Sultan's landmark visit appeared to put an end to years of tension and mistrust between the neighbours.
